legend.0: compact: A trivial change confined to one spot: a few lines such as a typo, a constant or timeout value, a one-line guard, a renamed identifier, or a sentence of documentation. It needs at most one small test adjustment. Adding a helper, restructuring a code path, or adding several regression cases is not compact.
legend.1: standard: A moderate change: a focused fix or improvement that edits a few files or a few hundred lines, restructures a code path or adds a helper, and adds or changes tests, but introduces no new architecture.
legend.2: deep: A large or cross-cutting change: many files or subsystems, a new feature or mechanism, architecture or design work, public API or schema or storage-format changes, or data migration.
